caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid propped open, revealing its interior and a row of glass bottles with round stoppers arranged inside. The chest is brown with black metal reinforcement at the corners and edges, and features a central lock plate and side handles. The interior lid and back wall of the chest are lined with a patterned material in light yellow, blue, and green tones, featuring a repeating design of curving blue lines and small leafy branches. Above the main illustration, there is a close-up detail of the patterned lining, showing the same design more clearly: wavy blue shapes surrounding clusters of small green leaves on a light yellow background. The artist's signature, "Gilbert Sackerman," appears at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Medicine Bottle Chest
